==Description==
'''Opulent Remains''' is a normal [[PVP]] map set in a water resort.

==Design & Path==
'''Opulent Remains''' contains two water resorts, only different in their colors and one side being flipped. Both resorts are surrounded by water, some small islands and a few grey statues. The resorts themselves contain a few tall buildings, lampposts and tables. The floor of the resort contains multiple cracks and has plants growing on it, suggesting it has been abandoned.

The path starts at the blue portal and ends at the red portal. It takes multiple long straights and turns, with a single loop in the midpoint.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Opulent Remains}}

==Strategy==
*The center point of this map is the ideal place for towers, due to its good path coverage and it being close to a cliff.
*The loop in the middle of this map is a decent spot for low range towers like the [[Sledger]] or [[Brawler]].
**The cross section of the path is also a great spot.
*It is recommended to place [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] at a spot that covers both the center point and the loop of the map, as most towers should be located there.

==Trivia==
*'''Opulent Remains''' is the finished version of [[PVP_7]].
*The intermission lobby lists {{RLinkU|SorenDerg}} as one of the creators. However, they were not actually involved in creating this map and have not even been active in the Tower Defense Simulator community since early 2023.
